# tsdf_ops

> HAZWOPER training for RCRA treatment, storage and disposal facilities: 24-hour TSD operations under 29 CFR 1910.120(p), annual refresher, waste technician and Cal/OSHA TSDF courses.

tsdf_ops (https://tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 24-Hr TSD Operations, 8-Hr TSD Refresher, Waste Technician, Cal/OSHA 24-Hr TSDF or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Guides

- [TSDF training under 1910.120(p): 24 hours, then 8 every year](https://tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/guides/tsdf-training-1910-120-p): Why TSD workers have their own paragraph in HAZWOPER, and what it requires.
- [TSDF or cleanup site? Why the 40-hour isn't the default at a TSDF](https://tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/guides/tsdf-vs-cleanup-site-training): Workers move between facilities and field jobs. Here's which HAZWOPER paragraph covers which work.
- [OSHA and EPA training records at a TSDF: one system for both](https://tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/guides/tsdf-training-records-osha-and-epa): TSDFs answer to two agencies for training. Here's how to keep one set of records that satisfies both.
